title: MediaInfoLib before 26.10 contains an uninitialized pointer dereference vulnerability because the…
description: MediaInfoLib versions before 26.10 have a vulnerability due to an uninitialized pointer dereference in the File_Mpeg4_Descriptors constructor. This flaw causes the IsCmaf pointer to hold stale heap data, which can lead to a crash when processing a crafted MP4 file containing an AAC/USAC decoder specific descriptor.
